profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
- Experienced in system design, data pipelines, full-stack web development, DevOps, business analysis, project management, and mentoring.
- Can spot an anti-pattern at 30 paces.
- Stand back! I know regular expressions!
- Genuinely excited about technology of all kinds.
- Loves bulleted lists.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developer on backend systems of Google Flights.

positions.description: - Developer on backend systems of Google Flights.

positions.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
positions.description: - Lead developer for suite of web-based diagnostic tools for enterprise Flights partners.

positions.title: Application Analyst Specialist
positions.description:
- Served as lead developer for several Java web applications supporting functions of Georgia state agencies and UGA campus departments.
- Served as primary client contact and project manager for several projects.
- Planned and executed multiple major refractors and platform migrations.
- Led componentization and reusability efforts across multiple software platforms (Java, PHP/Drupal, ASP.NET) based on observed development trends.
- Led adoption of issue tracker (Bugzilla) and implementation of continuous integration (Jenkins).
- Managed internal development services including Subversion, Bugzilla, Jenkins, Artifactory.
- Served as webmaster of onsite virtual servers running Apache Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server, IIS 6/7.5 using ARR.
- Coordinated with Systems group, planning server architecture based on the needs of all projects.
